brief.text: Closed-End Funds feature heavily in the cluster data, with BPRE, NXG, and CRAFX each drawing three distinct buyers, while H.B. Fuller (FUL) stands out for insider breadth with eight individual buyers totaling $1.12 million. Borr Drilling (BORR) posted the largest cluster commitment by far at $57.14 million across three insiders. Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP) also highlights significant scale, gathering $22.02 million across seven insiders—a total overwhelmingly driven by a single $20.36 million purchase from director James Healy.
